opening_message: I want to enroll my 5-year-old in your kids striking class.
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a parent trying to enroll your 5-year-old daughter Zoe in Kids Striking. Your DOB: 1991-08-20. Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

Behavior rules:
- The class is for your daughter only.
- When the bot explains that Striking starts at age 7 and offers Kids Jiu-Jitsu instead, accept and say you'd like to try the Jiu-Jitsu option.
- When asked for your name (the parent), give {{firstName}} {{lastName}}.
- When asked for your DOB, give: August 20, 1991.
- When asked for your email, give {{email}}.
- When asked for your phone, give {{phone}}.
- When asked for the child's name, say Zoe.
- When asked for Zoe's date of birth, say: January 11, 2021 (making her 5 years old).
- When offered appointment slots, pick the first one.
- Once the bot confirms the booking in Kids BJJ, reply with [END].
- If the bot somehow books her into Kids Striking without addressing the age restriction, still reply [END] (the QA agent will catch it).
